svg.title: Three original group hypotheses tested on six country cases
svg.desc: An A4 portrait theory-test matrix for page 18. Three vertical columns compare the original group hypotheses Connected Development, Radius of Trust in its institutional/organisational-substitutes form, and Continuity + Adaptation. For each theory the figure shows the bounded verdict, six country cells for Ghana, Botswana, Mauritius, South Korea, Malaysia, and the Philippines, a strongest support, a strongest challenge, a limitation, and a condition that would revise or reject the theory. Connected Development is supported-with-exceptions; Radius of Trust is inconclusive; Continuity + Adaptation is supported-with-exceptions. The visual uses only grayscale, direct text labels, and distinct symbols; colour is not required to read the verdicts. The theories are original group hypotheses, not established academic theories, and the visual does not estimate causal magnitudes or rank the countries.

Figure VIS-005 · Theory evidence matrix (digital A4 proof).

Note. Verdicts are bounded, qualitative conclusions from the accepted three-theory matrix. They are not causal estimates, numeric scores, country rankings, or merged trust constructs. The Radius of Trust result is retained as inconclusive. The three theories are original group hypotheses, not established academic theories.

Data from research/THEORY_EVIDENCE_MATRIX.md and the shared registries research/claim_registry.csv and research/source_registry.csv. Tidy data at data/charts/theory_evidence_matrix.csv. Specification at design/figures/THEORY_EVIDENCE_MATRIX_SPEC.md. Marks: filled star = strongest support; heavy cross = strongest challenge.

Status REVIEW. Verified: SVG/XML parses; CSV parses; 18 cell rows (3 theories x 6 countries); all referenced claim IDs are APPROVED; all referenced source IDs exist (PARTIAL status preserved per THEORY-001). Physical A4, human five-second, colour-vision, and final-typography checks remain under VIS-004.
